properties.description: Training signal only. Fires on a successful write to the disposable seceng-week13-signal resource group. Not a threat claim.
properties.displayName: Week 13 training signal: write to seceng-week13-signal
properties.query:
// Training signal only: a successful write to the disposable signal resource group.
// Unverified until run against real AzureActivity data; this is not a threat claim.
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30m)
| where ResourceGroup =~ "seceng-week13-signal"
| where OperationNameValue =~ "Microsoft.Resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups/write"
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, ResourceGroup, CorrelationId
